summary: One confirmed service-off gate bypass was reproduced and fixed. TypeOK and seven safety action-properties hold across 336 distinct bounded states (depth 12). Separate negative controls show the original gate bypass, healthy protected-response reachability, and the completion window for already-started review-content finalization.

modeled: One protected Worker request and one scheduled draft slot.
Enabled/disabled control state, control-store availability, admin authorization and revision values 0..2.

Protected request start/response acceptance, scheduled start, provider call start, post-provider check, review-content finalization start/completion, and failure-status bookkeeping after shutdown is observed.
abstracted: All protected routes share one gate; only the explicit health/status/admin-control/logout allowlist is exempt.
The Durable Object returns a linearizable valid snapshot or an error.

Three parallel draft slots are represented by one; provider output and D1 row data are opaque. `failClaim` status-only writes are represented by a `blocking` phase; review-content finalization may complete after shutdown if it started before shutdown.
out_of_scope: Cloudflare production deployment, real OAuth/Access tokens, D1 isolation behavior and external-provider internals.
Cancellation of an AI request or review-content finalization already started. A finalization that completes after shutdown may leave a private row which can remain after re-enable.
Liveness/eventual completion and all possible revision counts.
assumptions: Durable Object state reads/writes are linearizable within one control object.

Modeled actions follow actual asynchronous boundaries: the post-provider check starts or skips content finalization, an in-flight finalization completes in a separate action, and blocked-claim status bookkeeping contains no provider content.

A provider operation already started cannot be cancelled; if shutdown is observed before content finalization starts, its output is discarded. A finalization already started cannot be cancelled. `failClaim` may record failure status without generated content while OFF.

properties.name: TypeOK
properties.statement: Each control, request, scheduler, and revision variable remains in its declared finite domain.
properties.meaning: The model state is well-typed throughout every interleaving.
properties.bounds: UseServiceGate=true; MaxRevision=2; one request, one scheduled slot, one admin.

properties.name: ProtectedStartGuard
properties.statement: A protected request starts only while the service is enabled and the control state is available.
properties.meaning: Disabled or unreadable service state blocks protected routes before the handler/auth path.

properties.name: ProtectedFinishGuard
properties.statement: A protected response is accepted only if service state is still enabled and available at completion.
properties.meaning: An in-flight handler that completes during shutdown returns the service-disabled/unavailable response instead.

properties.name: ScheduledStartGuard
properties.statement: A scheduled generation starts only while service state is enabled and available.
properties.meaning: Cron does not start draft-generation work while the service is off or its control state cannot be read.

properties.name: ProviderStartGuard
properties.statement: A provider call starts only while service state is enabled and available.
properties.meaning: Shutdown during catalog or D1 awaits prevents a later AI-provider request from starting.

properties.name: ProviderPersistStartGuard
properties.statement: The D1 finalize write starts only while service state is enabled and available after the provider response.
properties.meaning: If shutdown is observed at the post-provider check, the D1 write is skipped; an already-started D1 write is handled separately as an in-flight side effect.

properties.name: BlockedStatusWriteGuard
properties.statement: The service-control-blocked failure status is recorded only after shutdown or control-store unavailability is observed.
properties.meaning: The blocked-claim status update is bookkeeping only and contains no generated title, excerpt, or body.

properties.name: AdminToggleGuard
properties.statement: A service-state change requires an authenticated administrator and an available control store.
properties.meaning: The kill switch cannot be changed by an unauthenticated caller or while DO state is unavailable.

properties.name: ScheduledStartGuard (mutated gate)
properties.statement: The fixed route/scheduler gate is disabled (`UseServiceGate=false`) and must be detected.
properties.meaning: A deliberately ungated scheduler can start while control state is unavailable.

properties.name: SanityNeverAccepted
properties.statement: Sanity-only false property: no protected request is ever accepted.
properties.meaning: The healthy request path is reachable; this invariant must fail to rule out vacuous passing.

properties.name: NoReviewFinalizeAfterShutdown (known async boundary)
properties.statement: A review-content finalization that started while enabled cannot finish after shutdown.
properties.meaning: Intentionally false limitation check: an already-started content finalization can finish after shutdown; while OFF, protected draft routes remain gated. No guarantee is made that the private row is absent after re-enable. `failClaim` status-only bookkeeping is separately modeled and contains no generated content.

properties.name: BlockedStatusReachabilitySanity
properties.meaning: Intentional invariant counterexample: after the control store becomes unavailable during scheduler loading, SkipProvider reaches the blocking phase. This confirms the status-only failure path is reachable; it is not a product safety defect.

findings.title: Service-off bypass through blog drafts and scheduled AI
findings.story: The original route allowlist exempted admin blog-draft list/review calls, so disabled service reached admin authentication and returned 403 instead of service_disabled. The Cron handler never read the global control state, allowing draft generation while disabled or while the state store failed. Shutdown during catalog loading, provider execution, or before review-content finalization starts is now rechecked. If OFF occurs after finalization starts, that private write may still complete; `failClaim` may record status-only bookkeeping without generated content.

reproduction.test: backend/cloudflare/tests/blog-drafts.test.js::daily scheduler skips generation while the global service is disabled; backend/cloudflare/tests/service-control.test.js::disabled mode blocks protected routes before session authentication

fix.summary: Removed blog-draft APIs from the control-plane exception allowlist; the scheduled handler now fails closed on disabled/unavailable DO state; generation rechecks before provider calls and review-content finalization.
fix.diff: `isControlPlane` now matches only the spec allowlist. `scheduled` passes a fail-closed state checker to `generateDailyDrafts`; each slot checks it before claim/provider and after provider response. OFF status is recorded without generated content; once review-content finalization starts, it is not cancelled if shutdown happens during that write.

sanity_checks: MC_sanity.cfg intentionally violates SanityNeverAccepted; a protected request acceptance is reachable.
MC_bug.cfg with UseServiceGate=false intentionally violates ScheduledStartGuard.
MC_boundary.cfg intentionally violates NoReviewFinalizeAfterShutdown to expose content finalization already in flight completing during shutdown.
MC.cfg -coverage 1 records positive coverage for every model action.
MC_blockedstatus.cfg intentionally violates NoBlockedStatusReached; the cex reaches the blocking phase via SkipProvider after ControlUnavailable. This is an expected reachability witness, not a bug.
